description: Docker's containers, images, volumes, networks and Compose projects on the host, read and acted on through its docker CLI: its contexts and the sidebar's categories (contexts), a category's objects (list), an object inspected (inspect), a container's or Compose project's log as it is now (logs), a command run in a running container (exec: no terminal, its output when it ends), and a container or Compose project started, stopped, restarted or removed (start, stop, restart, remove; an image, a volume or a network removed).

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

context.description: The context, by its name, as contexts lists it.

page.description: list, inspect, logs, exec and the actions: the category's page, by its key.

id.description: inspect, logs, exec and the actions: the object, by its id (a Compose project's, its name).

format.description: inspect: as JSON (the default) or YAML.

tail.description: logs: its last this many lines (the Docker view's number if none).

command.description: exec: what's run, its argv (docker exec, with no terminal and nothing on its stdin).

timeout.description: exec: seconds it may run (60 if none; 600 at most): then it's stopped.
